metric_drive_loss.prompt_directive: Drive validation loss below 0.1 on the demo training tool.
metric_drive_loss.raw_response:
```json
[
  {
    "criterion_id": "val_loss_below_threshold",
    "kind": "metric_threshold",
    "metric": "metrics.val_loss",
    "op": "<",
    "target": 0.1,
    "required": true
  },
  {
    "criterion_id": "find_examples_succeeded",
    "kind": "tool_call_succeeded",
    "tool_name": "find_examples",
    "min_count": 1,
    "required": true
  },
  {
    "criterion_id": "no_errors",
    "kind": "predicate",
    "expression": "len(obs.get('errors', [])) == 0",
    "required": false
  },
  {
    "criterion_id": "val_loss_metric_present",
    "kind": "predicate",
    "expression": "any(k == 'val_loss' for k in obs['metrics'].keys())",
    "required": true
  },
  {
    "criterion_id": "all_tools_ok",
    "kind": "predicate",
    "expression": "all(r.get('_status') == 'ok' for r in obs['tool_results'])",
    "required": false
  }
]
```
